sensor_quality_flags.model_fidelity: SYNOPTIC GCM SIMULATION (LMD Mars Global Circulation Model v6.1)

source_metadata.platform: Laboratoire de Météorologie Dynamique (LMD) / CNES / ESA
source_metadata.archive_citation: Forget et al., Improved 3D Model of the Martian Atmosphere, J. Geophys. Res. 104, 24155–24176 (1999); Millour et al., MCD 6.1 Documentation (2022).

climatological_context.model_variance_note: Extreme low pressure (72 Pa, ~0.72 mbar) reflects 21 km altitude; represents near-vacuum conditions compared to mean Martian surface datum (610 Pa).

warnings: DATA IS MODELLED CLIMATOLOGY: No in-situ meteorological station exists on Olympus Mons summit.
disclosures: Values represent numerically integrated GCM climatological means, NOT empirical in-situ observations.
Do NOT treat this output as a real-time weather forecast; values are climatological averages.
